import heapq

class FlowNetwork:
    def __init__(self, vertex_count):
        self.V = vertex_count
        self.edge_indices = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(vertex_count)]

    def add_edge(self, u, v, capacity, cost):
        idx = len(self.edge_indices)
        self.edge_indices.append((u, len(self.adj[u])))
        self.adj[u].append(self._Link(v, len(self.adj[v]), capacity, cost))
        self.adj[v].append(self._Link(u, len(self.adj[u]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return idx

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, source, target, capacity, flow, cost):
            self.source = source
            self.target = target
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get_edge(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edge_indices[i]
        forward = self.adj[u][pos]
        backward = self.adj[forward.target][forward.rev]
        return self.Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost)

    def list_edges(self):
        result = []
        for i in range(len(self.edge_indices)):
            u, pos = self.edge_indices[i]
            forward = self.adj[u][pos]
            backward = self.adj[forward.target][forward.rev]
            result.append(self.Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost))
        return result

    def _reweight(self, source, sink):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge_index = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_spt = [False] * self.V
        heap = [source]
        self.dist[source] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.in_spt[v]:
                continue
            self.in_spt[v] = True
            if v == sink:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj[v])):
                e = self.adj[v][i]
                if self.in_spt[e.target] or e.capacity == 0:
                    continue
                reduced_cost = e.cost - self.potential[e.target] + self.potential[v]
                if self.dist[e.target] > self.dist[v] + reduced_cost:
                    self.dist[e.target] = self.dist[v] + reduced_cost
                    self.parent[e.target] = v
                    self.parent_edge_index[e.target] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.dist[e.target] << 32) + e.target))
        if not self.in_spt[sink]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.V):
            if not self.in_spt[i]:
                continue
            self.potential[i] -= self.dist[sink] - self.dist[i]
        return True

    def pareto(self, source, sink, flow_cap=4294967295):
        self.potential = [0] * self.V
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.V
        self.parent = [-1] * self.V
        self.parent_edge_index = [-1] * self.V
        self.in_spt = [False] * self.V
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        last_cost = -1
        points = [(total_flow, total_cost)]
        while total_flow < flow_cap:
            if not self._reweight(source, sink):
                break
            bottleneck = flow_cap - total_flow
            node = sink
            while node != source:
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, self.adj[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge_index[node]].capacity)
                node = self.parent[node]
            node = sink
            while node != source:
                e = self.adj[self.parent[node]][self.parent_edge_index[node]]
                e.capacity -= bottleneck
                self.adj[node][e.rev].capacity += bottleneck
                node = self.parent[node]
            d = -self.potential[source]
            total_flow += bottleneck
            total_cost += bottleneck * d
            if last_cost == d:
                points.pop()
            points.append((total_flow, total_cost))
            last_cost = d
        return points

    def max_flow_min_cost(self, source, sink, flow_cap=4294967295):
        return self.pareto(source, sink, flow_cap)[-1]

    class _Link:
        def __init__(self, target, rev, capacity, cost):
            self.target = target
            self.rev = rev
            self.capacity = capacity
            self.cost = cost

b1, b2, b3 = map(int, input().split())

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class FlowNetwork {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int source;
        int target;
        int capacity;
        int flow;
        int cost;
        Edge(int s, int t, int cap, int fl, int c) : source(s), target(t), capacity(cap), flow(fl), cost(c) {}
    };

    struct _Link {
        int target;
        int rev;
        int capacity;
        int cost;
        _Link(int t, int r, int cap, int c) : target(t), rev(r), capacity(cap), cost(c) {}
    };

    FlowNetwork(int vertex_count) : V(vertex_count) {
        adj.resize(vertex_count);
    }

    int add_edge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
        int idx = edge_indices.size();
        edge_indices.push_back(make_pair(u, adj[u].size()));
        adj[u].push_back(_Link(v, adj[v].size(), capacity, cost));
        adj[v].push_back(_Link(u, adj[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        return idx;
    }

    Edge get_edge(int i) {
        int u = edge_indices[i].first;
        int pos = edge_indices[i].second;
        _Link& forward = adj[u][pos];
        _Link& backward = adj[forward.target][forward.rev];
        return Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost);
    }

    vector<Edge> list_edges() {
        vector<Edge> result;
        for (int i = 0; i < edge_indices.size(); i++) {
            int u = edge_indices[i].first;
            int pos = edge_indices[i].second;
            _Link& forward = adj[u][pos];
            _Link& backward = adj[forward.target][forward.rev];
            result.push_back(Edge(u, forward.target, forward.capacity + backward.capacity, backward.capacity, forward.cost));
        }
        return result;
    }

    bool _reweight(int source, int sink) {
        dist.assign(V, 4294967295);
        parent.assign(V, -1);
        parent_edge_index.assign(V, -1);
        in_spt.assign(V, false);
        priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<pair<int, int>>> heap;
        dist[source] = 0;
        heap.push({0, source});
        
        while (!heap.empty()) {
            int v = heap.top().second;
            heap.pop();
            if (in_spt[v]) continue;
            in_spt[v] = true;
            if (v == sink) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj[v].size(); i++) {
                _Link& e = adj[v][i];
                if (in_spt[e.target] || e.capacity == 0) continue;
                int reduced_cost = e.cost - potential[e.target] + potential[v];
                if (dist[e.target] > dist[v] + reduced_cost) {
                    dist[e.target] = dist[v] + reduced_cost;
                    parent[e.target] = v;
                    parent_edge_index[e.target] = i;
                    heap.push({dist[e.target], e.target});
                }
            }
        }
        if (!in_spt[sink]) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
            if (!in_spt[i]) continue;
            potential[i] -= dist[sink] - dist[i];
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> pareto(int source, int sink, int flow_cap = 4294967295) {
        potential.assign(V, 0);
        dist.assign(V, 4294967295);
        parent.assign(V, -1);
        parent_edge_index.assign(V, -1);
        in_spt.assign(V, false);
        int total_flow = 0;
        int total_cost = 0;
        int last_cost = -1;
        vector<pair<int, int>> points;
        points.push_back({total_flow, total_cost});
        
        while (total_flow < flow_cap) {
            if (!_reweight(source, sink)) break;
            int bottleneck = flow_cap - total_flow;
            int node = sink;
            while (node != source) {
                bottleneck = min(bottleneck, adj[parent[node]][parent_edge_index[node]].capacity);
                node = parent[node];
            }
            node = sink;
            while (node != source) {
                _Link& e = adj[parent[node]][parent_edge_index[node]];
                e.capacity -= bottleneck;
                adj[node][e.rev].capacity += bottleneck;
                node = parent[node];
            }
            int d = -potential[source];
            total_flow += bottleneck;
            total_cost += bottleneck * d;
            if (last_cost == d) {
                points.pop_back();
            }
            points.push_back({total_flow, total_cost});
            last_cost = d;
        }
        return points;
    }

    pair<int, int> max_flow_min_cost(int source, int sink, int flow_cap = 4294967295) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> points = pareto(source, sink, flow_cap);
        return points.back();
    }

private:
    int V;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edge_indices;
    vector<vector<_Link>> adj;
    vector<int> potential;
    vector<int> dist;
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<int> parent_edge_index;
    vector<bool> in_spt;
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int a1, a2, a3;
    int b1, b2, b3;
    cin >> a1 >> a2 >> a3;
    cin >> b1 >> b2 >> b3;

    FlowNetwork g(8);
    g.add_edge(0, 1, a1, 0);
    g.add_edge(0, 2, a2, 0);
    g.add_edge(0, 3, a3, 0);
    g.add_edge(4, 7, b1, 0);
    g.add_edge(5, 7, b2, 0);
    g.add_edge(6, 7, b3, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
            int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
            g.add_edge(i, j, INT_MAX, cost);
        }
    }

    pair<int, int> result = g.max_flow_min_cost(0, 7);
    int ans1 = result.second;
    int ans2 = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1);
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
